description: Termination and payment clauses from contracts and leases.

key.instructions: Either party may end the agreement early

not_key.instructions: Neither party can end the agreement before its term is over

s2.instructions: A party may have to pay a penalty

s3.instructions: The clause involves a payment of money

cases.state: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 30 days' written notice.
This Agreement may not be terminated by either party before the end of the Initial Term.
Either party may terminate this Agreement early on 60 days' notice, provided the terminating party pays an early termination penalty equal to two months of fees.
Neither party may terminate this Agreement before the end of the term. Fees for the full term are payable in advance.
Each party may end this lease before the end of the term by giving the other party three months' written notice.
This lease runs for a fixed term of 12 months and cannot be ended early by the landlord or the tenant.
A late-payment penalty of $500 applies to any invoice paid after 30 days. Either party may terminate this Agreement at any time on 14 days' notice.
A late-payment penalty of $500 applies to any invoice paid after 30 days. The Agreement remains in force for its full term and neither party may terminate it early.
